correctness.rationale: The assigned derivation correctly takes h_m=1/[2(m-1)], D_{m+1}=D_m+I_m, L_{m+1}=L_m+1-J_m, conditional E[I_m]=h_m D_m, E[J_m]=h_m L_m, E[I_m J_m]=h_m 1_{D_m=1}. Hence c_{m+1}-c_m=h_m² a_m b_m-h_m q_m. First moments solve q_m=binom(2m-4,m-2)/4^{m-2}, a_m=(2m-3)q_m, b_m=2(m-1)/3+4q_m/3; algebra and telescoping give the finite boxed sum. Sign is 0 at n=2,3 and >0 n>=4; central-binomial asymptotic gives 2 sqrt n/(3sqrt pi). Root D(D+1) and leaf variance recurrences give Var D/n ->2-4/pi and Var L/n->1/9, yielding corr ~ sqrt(2/(pi-2))/sqrt n. Independent exact parent-history enumeration through n=8 verified the assigned sum equals the earlier published increment formula and actual covariance.
